$comment: Stage target for bun run release:run (D61 rule 2): the same steps as prod.json, against the stage target database that scripts/release/stage-target.ts up restores before the run. No release commit here: the go file's commit: line names it. HOME is a dedicated directory whose .env names that database. The legacy stack is the v0.5.4 checkout booted against it (PR 1229). watchMinAttendance is 0.4 on stage: the four external members file against production, never against the stage database, so a stage session holds at most the three in-house takes of seven active members (3/7 = 0.43). Production keeps the gate's default 0.5 (owner-visible, 2026-10-08). watchHours 0.25 and watchSessions deferred: the owner decided on 2026-10-08 that the stage watch is a 15-minute check. W1 runs prod:gate with --sessions deferred and R7.4a skips the in-flight publish check, because no 6 h epoch closes in 15 minutes. Stage epochs stay 6 h. Production keeps the 10 h graded watch, so production's W1 is the first full session proof.

legacy.startedBy: SMOKE_PROJECT=stage_target bun run smoke:archive -- --no-tui (= bun scripts/smoke.ts --smoke --static-port --db external) in tmux session stage-driver
